meta.title: International security knowledge network, c. 1966-2026
meta.description: Key works and theme nodes in top-journal international security research. Seeds come from this repo's papers.json (Zotero); most other works were selected from the top-cited 2006-2026 articles in fifteen journals via Crossref, plus anchoring books and classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. The 150 Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. The 29 anchors were looked up in Crossref: 28 confirmed (books often via reviews or reprint DOIs); Waltz 1979 has no Crossref record. Repo entries with missing titles or authors were corrected from Crossref. All one-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
